title: Ginga Ojousama Densetsu Yuna Remix
native_title: 銀河お嬢様伝説 ユナ リミックス
overview: Yuna Remix is a remake of the original PC Engine game. The gameplay and story are identical to the original release, but this version features completely redrawn graphics at a higher quality, newly-arranged music, and additional newly-recorded voiceovers. There is also some additional bonus content such as an illustration gallery. The package also includes a 1997 calendar featuring new artwork by series illustrator Mika Akitaka.
